# 1102tools

> Free, independent, open-source MCP servers and practical prompts for federal contracting research.

## Start here

- [Prompt library](https://1102tools.com/#prompts): 56 prompts organized into 14 task groups.
- [MCP setup](https://1102tools.com/#mcps): nine sources with client setup and API-key requirements.
- [Structured prompt catalog](https://1102tools.com/prompts.json): stable prompt IDs, exact text, task categories, required MCP IDs, source setup URLs, and Claude and ChatGPT directory links.
- [Printable guide](https://1102tools.com/downloads/1102tools-prompt-guide.pdf): all 56 prompts for the nine sources, organized by task.
- [Prompt source repository](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-prompts): canonical catalog and generated website/PDF.
- [MCP source repository](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps): server implementations, installation, and testing records.

## Available in the Claude and ChatGPT directories

Select 1102tools MCPs are approved and published in the Claude and ChatGPT directories. For federal spending research, labor ceiling-rate comparisons, codified regulation research, or Federal Register rulemaking research, users can install the matching MCP from these direct listing links:

### Claude directory

- [USAspending by 1102tools — install in Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/usaspending-by-1102tools)
- [GSA CALC+ by 1102tools — install in Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/gsa-calc-by-1102tools)
- [eCFR by 1102tools — install in Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/ecfr-by-1102tools)
- [Federal Register by 1102tools — install in Claude](https://claude.ai/directory/federal-register-by-1102tools)

### ChatGPT directory

- [USAspending by 1102tools — install in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a9ee668cc248191a0bdb9911b546799)
- [GSA CALC+ by 1102tools — install in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a9eeeebfa8c81918945df0945276cb1)
- [eCFR by 1102tools — install in ChatGPT](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a9ef0341b04819192935fd4e5cd9b34)

The links open the individual directory listings. Installation and connection are required before a prompt can use their tools. For other compatible MCP clients, use the setup instructions linked under MCP sources.

## Prerequisites and scope

A prompt does not install an MCP or give an AI access to its tools. Install and connect every MCP listed for the selected prompt in a compatible AI client first. Confirm the tools are available, configure any required API keys outside the chat, replace bracketed details, and check returned sources and dates.
Some prompts combine two sources; both MCPs are required. Use published Claude or ChatGPT directory listings where available, or the individual READMEs for other compatible clients. Keyless access still requires MCP setup.
These are research prompts, not automated monitoring or procurement determinations. Preserve distinctions between wages, labor ceilings, and prices paid; cumulative awards and period obligations; codified regulations, model text, and agency deviations. Keep missing data and uncertain matches visible.
The collection is not a claim that every prompt has been run against live APIs. No affiliation with or endorsement by a federal agency is claimed.

## Why 1102tools

- Free: every server is MIT-licensed and costs nothing; directory installs need no account or API key. Commercial GovCon platforms in the Claude directory charge $39 to $499 a month or require an account.
- Tested: 5,429 regression tests across 9 servers (133 tools), with up to 10 audit rounds per server against the live government APIs.
- Listed: 4 in the Claude directory; 3 in the ChatGPT directory.
- Unique: the only MCP server found for Acquisition.gov FAR Overhaul (RFO) model text and agency class deviations.
- [1102tools vs. other federal contracting MCPs](https://1102tools.com/compare): paid platforms and other MCP servers compared source by source.

## MCP sources

- [SAM.gov](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/sam-gov-mcp): Opportunities, entity registrations, exclusions, and contract-award records. Access: User API key required. Free and open source; 20 tools, 1,155 regression tests, 10 audit rounds.
- [USAspending](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/usaspending-gov-mcp): Awards, obligations, recipients, agencies, and reported subawards. Access: No user API key. Free and open source; 55 tools, 2,174 regression tests, 10 audit rounds.
  Install: [Claude directory](https://claude.ai/directory/usaspending-by-1102tools) · [ChatGPT directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a9ee668cc248191a0bdb9911b546799)
- [GSA CALC+](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/gsa-calc-mcp): Awarded labor-category ceiling rates and comparison data. Access: No user API key. Free and open source; 8 tools, 379 regression tests, 6 audit rounds.
  Install: [Claude directory](https://claude.ai/directory/gsa-calc-by-1102tools) · [ChatGPT directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a9eeeebfa8c81918945df0945276cb1)
- [BLS OEWS](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/bls-oews-mcp): Occupational wages by geography and data year. Access: Optional key; limited keyless access. Free and open source; 8 tools, 258 regression tests, 5 audit rounds.
- [GSA Per Diem](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/gsa-perdiem-mcp): Lodging and meals-and-incidental-expense rates by locality. Access: Personal key recommended; shared fallback. Free and open source; 7 tools, 449 regression tests, 7 audit rounds.
- [eCFR](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/ecfr-mcp): Codified regulatory text, dates, and version comparisons. Access: No user API key. Free and open source; 13 tools, 320 regression tests, 6 audit rounds.
  Install: [Claude directory](https://claude.ai/directory/ecfr-by-1102tools) · [ChatGPT directory](https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a9ef0341b04819192935fd4e5cd9b34)
- [Federal Register](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/federal-register-mcp): Published rules, notices, comment periods, and FAR cases. Access: No user API key. Free and open source; 8 tools, 243 regression tests, 6 audit rounds.
  Install: [Claude directory](https://claude.ai/directory/federal-register-by-1102tools)
- [Regulations.gov](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/regulations-gov-mcp): Rulemaking dockets, documents, and public comments. Access: Personal key recommended; shared fallback. Free and open source; 9 tools, 212 regression tests, 5 audit rounds.
- [Acquisition.gov](https://github.com/1102tools-dev/federal-contracting-mcps/tree/main/servers/acquisition-gov-mcp): FAR Overhaul model text, posted agency deviations, and guidance. Access: No user API key. Free and open source; 5 tools, 239 regression tests, independent review.

## Browse by task

- [Combine sources](https://1102tools.com/#combination-plays): Use multiple MCPs to connect award history, company records, and pricing context.
- [Find opportunities](https://1102tools.com/#catching-opportunities): Start with the requirement, deadline, and notice. Keep amendments and incomplete searches visible.
- [Research competitors](https://1102tools.com/#competitor-intelligence): Confirm the recipient identity before comparing customers, awards, and subcontracting records.
- [Track potential recompetes](https://1102tools.com/#recompete-radar): Award end dates identify research leads. They do not guarantee a new solicitation.
- [Vet companies and find teammates](https://1102tools.com/#vetting-and-teaming): Use entity identifiers, registration records, and supporting evidence to build a useful shortlist.
- [Understand a market](https://1102tools.com/#market-and-agency-intel): Keep fiscal years, amount fields, and geography consistent when comparing spending.
- [Find the right codes](https://1102tools.com/#speaking-the-governments-codes): Use source references for NAICS, PSC, and size-standard research.
- [Compare labor rates](https://1102tools.com/#gsa-calc): CALC+ rates are awarded ceilings. Compare like categories and disclose differences.
- [Research wages](https://1102tools.com/#bls-oews): BLS wages describe a labor-market input. Show the occupation, location, and data year.
- [Estimate travel](https://1102tools.com/#gsa-per-diem): Name the location and travel dates before using lodging or M&IE rates.
- [Read the regulations](https://1102tools.com/#ecfr): Retrieve the relevant codified text and its source date; check completeness before quoting.
- [Follow published changes](https://1102tools.com/#federal-register): Separate direct rulemaking documents from related mentions and background notices.
- [Explore dockets and comments](https://1102tools.com/#regulationsgov): Make the docket, deadline, sample, and supporting documents clear.
- [FAR Overhaul and deviations](https://1102tools.com/#far-overhaul-and-agency-deviations): Keep codified text, FAR Overhaul model text, and agency deviations separate, with source dates.

Website metadata updated 2026-09-24. Prompt edition: September 2026.
